name: Azerbaijan
summary: Using drugs or holding less than the legal 'significant amount' is an administrative offence (fine 300–400 AZN or up to 2 months' arrest); more is a crime (up to 3 yrs; dealing 3–7 yrs, more if aggravated).
callingForHelp: No Good Samaritan law. Voluntarily handing over drugs exempts from liability; refusing a medical drug test is fined (300–400 AZN).

lsd.note: Listed. Below the legal 'significant amount': fine 300–400 AZN or up to 2 months' arrest; above it: up to 3 yrs.

mushrooms.note: Psilocybin/psilocin are listed; mushrooms are presumably treated likewise. Small amounts: fine or arrest.

dmt.note: DMT is listed (ayahuasca contains DMT). Below the legal 'significant amount': fine 300–400 AZN or up to 2 months' arrest; above it: up to 3 yrs.

mescaline.note: Mescaline is listed; status of cacti not confirmed. Below the legal 'significant amount': fine 300–400 AZN or up to 2 months' arrest; above it: up to 3 yrs.

dox.note: DOM and DOB are listed. Below the legal 'significant amount': fine 300–400 AZN or up to 2 months' arrest; above it: up to 3 yrs.

nbomes.note: 25B-, 25C-, 25I-NBOMe are listed. Below the legal 'significant amount': fine 300–400 AZN or up to 2 months' arrest; above it: up to 3 yrs.

2c-x.note: 2C-B is listed. Below the legal 'significant amount': fine 300–400 AZN or up to 2 months' arrest; above it: up to 3 yrs.

2c-t-x.note: 2C-T compounds were not found by name in the national lists (not UN-controlled).

5-meo-xxt.note: 5-MeO tryptamines were not found by name in the national lists (not UN-controlled).

cannabis.note: Small amounts and small-scale cultivation for own use are administrative offences (fine or up to 2 months' arrest); more is a crime.

ketamine.note: Ketamine was not found on the narcotic/psychotropic lists (only methoxyketamine); hospital anaesthetic.

mxe.note: Methoxetamine is listed. Below the legal 'significant amount': fine 300–400 AZN or up to 2 months' arrest; above it: up to 3 yrs.

dxm.note: Since May 2024 single-ingredient dextromethorphan is a controlled psychotropic (List III); combination cold medicines are exempt.

nitrous.note: Nitrous oxide is not on the controlled-substance lists.

amphetamines.note: Amphetamines and methylphenidate are listed. Below the legal 'significant amount': fine 300–400 AZN or up to 2 months' arrest; above it: up to 3 yrs.

mdma.note: MDMA is listed. Below the legal 'significant amount': fine 300–400 AZN or up to 2 months' arrest; above it: up to 3 yrs.

cocaine.note: Cocaine is listed. Below the legal 'significant amount': fine 300–400 AZN or up to 2 months' arrest; above it: up to 3 yrs.

caffeine.note: Not controlled; selling energy drinks to minors is fined (CAO 455.2).

alcohol.note: Selling alcohol to minors (under 18) is fined; minimum retail prices apply (CAO 455).

ghb/gbl.note: GHB, GBL and 1,4-butanediol were not found by name in the national lists, although GHB is UN Schedule II.

opioids.note: Heroin, morphine, oxycodone, fentanyl are listed. Small amounts: fine/arrest; more: up to 3 yrs. Rx opioids need a prescription.

tramadol.note: Tramadol was not found on the narcotic/psychotropic lists; prescription medicine.

benzodiazepines.note: Controlled psychotropics (List III), prescription-only; unprescribed use is an administrative offence.

maois.note: MAOI antidepressants are prescription-only; harmala alkaloids were not found on the lists; ayahuasca contains DMT.
